annotations.text: On December 14th, prices of U. S. Steel and Bethlehem Steel were recorded in the Natural Rally column. Refer to Explanatory Rule 6-D.
On December 28th, the price of Bethlehem Steel was recorded in the Upward Trend column in black ink, being a price higher than the last price previously recorded in that column.
On January 4th, the next trend of the market was being indicated according to the Livermore method. Refer to Explanatory Rules 10-A and B.
On January 12th, prices of U. S. Steel and Bethlehem Steel were recorded in the Secondary Reaction column. Refer to Explanatory Rule 6-H.

notes:
Ledger grid is on the RIGHT page (p.115); printed annotations on the LEFT page (p.114). Year header at top-left of the DATE column reads 1938. The year changes to 1939 mid-chart: a small handwritten "1939" appears above the "JAN.3" row (Jan 2, 1939 was a Monday holiday — New Year's observed — so the sequence goes SAT.31 [Dec 31] then JAN.3). Date rows run Dec 9, 1938 through Jan 21, 1939 (trading Mon-Sat; Sundays and the Dec 26 Christmas-observed holiday skipped).

Ink conventions hold throughout: UPWARD TREND entries in black ink; the four rally/reaction blue columns (SR, NR, NRC, SRC) in blue pencil; no DOWNWARD TREND (red) entries appear on this spread. All KEY PRICE = U.S. Steel + Bethlehem Steel checksums verified and hold on every row where all three are present (used to disambiguate the Dec 15 US fraction 67 1/8 and KP 143 1/2).

Column notes: Dec 14/15/28 US, BS, KP entries are in NATURAL RALLY (annotation confirms Dec 14). On Dec 28 BS alone advanced to UPWARD TREND (78, black) while US stayed NR and KP stayed NR (145 3/4, blue, since 145 3/4 < the 148 7/8 UT pivot). On Jan 4 BS 80 and KP 150 are UPWARD TREND (black) with red single underlines (150 exceeds the 148 7/8 pivot); US 70 remained NATURAL RALLY (blue, no underline). The Jan 11 BS 73 3/4 and Jan 12 US 62 5/8 / BS 71 1/2 / KP 134 1/8, and the Jan 21 US 62 / BS 69 1/2 / KP 131 1/2, are all in the SECONDARY REACTION (rightmost) column of each group — confirmed by grid-column measurement and the Jan 12 annotation.

All six carried-forward header pivotal points (US/BS/KP Upward-Trend and Natural-Reaction values) carry single red underlines.
